page.title: Replication
page.description: Ready-to-run replicas for fast disaster recovery. Manage replication jobs, then see exactly which host each VM fails over to.

empty.title: No replication yet
empty.description: Create a replication job to keep a ready-to-run copy of a VM on a target host — fail over in seconds, fail back when the source is healthy.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search replication jobs by name or scope…

empty.noJobsDescription: Create a replication job to keep ready-to-run copies of your VMs on a target host for fast failover.
empty.noMatchDescription: Try a different search term or status filter.

started.title: Started {{name}}
started.description: Watch the sync stream live in Activity.

paused.title: {{name}} is paused
paused.description: Enable the job to run it.

alreadyRunning.title: {{name}} is already running
alreadyRunning.description: Let the current sync finish first.

enabled.title: {{name}} enabled
enabled.description: It will resync on its next scheduled window.

pausedToggle.title: {{name}} paused
pausedToggle.description: It won't resync until you re-enable it.

deleted.title: Deleted {{name}}
deleted.description: Standby replicas were removed; any live failover is kept.

deleteFailed.title: Couldn't delete {{name}}
deleteFailed.description: The appliance didn't confirm — the job is untouched.

bulkStarted.someSkipped: Some were paused or already running.

bulkDeleted.description: Standby replicas removed; live failovers kept.

bulkDeletedPartial.title: Deleted {{deleted}} of {{total}} jobs
bulkDeletedPartial.description: The appliance didn't confirm the rest — they are untouched.

empty.noReplicatedDescription: Create a replication job to keep a ready-to-run copy of a VM on a target host, then watch the topology light up here.
empty.noMatchDescription: Try a different search term, or clear the filter to see the whole topology.

desc.failover: <1>{{name}}</1> is currently failed over and can't be deleted yet.
desc.hasVm: This permanently deletes the standby replica <1>{{name}}</1> for {{source}} on {{target}}. The replica VM and {{points}} will be removed from the target host. This can't be undone.
desc.noVm: This permanently deletes the standby replica <1>{{name}}</1> for {{source}}. Its seed never finished materializing a VM on {{target}}, so deleting it clears its record and {{points}} — there's no VM on the host to remove. This can't be undone.

banner.failoverTitle: This replica is currently failed over
banner.failoverBody: It's powered on and serving as the live workload. Fail back to the source or undo the failover before deleting it.
banner.reseedBody: <1>{{job}}</1> will create a fresh replica on its next run — a full read and transfer of the source. Your source VM and the replication job are not affected.

toast.successRemoved: Removed from {{target}}. “{{job}}” re-seeds a full replica on its next run.
toast.successCleared: The replica record was cleared. “{{job}}” seeds a fresh replica on its next run.
toast.errorBody: The appliance didn't confirm the deletion. Nothing was removed — try again.

failback.title: Fail back to {{name}}?
failback.description: AltaStor syncs changes made on the replica back to the original source, powers the replica down, and returns <1>{{name}}</1> to production. The replica goes back to standby and resumes protecting the source.
failback.toastBody: Control returned to the source · {{replica}} is on standby again.

undo.title: Undo failover of {{name}}?
undo.description: This <1>discards everything the replica wrote</1> while it was serving, powers it down, and puts it back on standby — as if the failover never happened. Use this when the source is healthy and you don't want the replica's changes.
undo.toastBody: Failover writes discarded · the replica is back on standby.

confirm.errorBody: Check the target host connection and try again.

failover.title: Fail over to {{name}}?
failover.description: The replica powers on and starts serving on <1>{{env}}</1>{{hostSuffix}}. The source <3>{{source}}</3> is taken out of rotation until you fail back.

planned.title: Planned
planned.description: Graceful. Run a final sync so nothing is lost, then cut over.

unplanned.title: Unplanned
unplanned.description: Disaster. The source is gone — boot the replica from a recovery point now.

failover.noPoints: No recovery points available yet — this replica has nothing to boot from.

hint.unplanned: Pick the last point you trust — anything written to the source after this is not on the replica.
hint.planned: A final sync runs first, so the latest point captures the source right up to cutover.

banner.unplanned: <1>No final sync.</1> Writes made to {{source}} after the chosen point are lost. Use this only when the source is unreachable.
banner.planned: AltaStor runs one last incremental sync, powers the source down, then brings the replica up on {{platform}}. Failback later returns control to the source.

toast.title: {{name}} is now serving
toast.unplanned: Unplanned failover complete — the replica is powered on on {{env}}.
toast.planned: Planned failover complete — a final sync ran and the replica is live on {{env}}.
toast.errorBody: The replica was not brought online. Check the target host connection and try again.
